⠴ Working...

I'll refactor the openai client to route through the local proxy. The
current handler hardcodes the upstream base URL, so I'm extracting it into
a config field and threading it through the request builder.

```go
type Client struct {
    baseURL string
    http    *http.Client
}

func NewClient(baseURL string) *Client {
    return &Client{baseURL: baseURL, http: &http.Client{}}
}
```

The proxy forwards to gpt-4o-mini for the cheap lane and deepseek-v4-pro-high
for the heavy lane, so the base URL is the only thing that changes per call.
